source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send OEM command to get FAN speed : ipmitool raw 0x30 0x22
2. Check all Fan control mode and Fan speed.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Completion Code
2. Control Mode
       1h = Manually Control
       0h = Auto Control (Default, follow fan control algorithm)
3. Fan PWM Duty Cycle
       00h ~ 64h for 0% ~ 100% PWM duty cycle

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Get Fan Speed Control: read the current fan speed control mode + fan speeds ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sensor list 2>&1 | grep -iE "FAN|SPD_FAN" and the control mode ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" raw 0x30 0x30 0x01 0x02 2>&1.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the fan RPM sensor list + control-mode read so the user confirms fan speed control reports correctly.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES substitutes a different raw read command, passes credentials on the CLI and greps fan text without completion-code/schema decoding, complete topology, units or freshness.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires an authoritative protected read command, decoded mode/duty, complete mapped fan telemetry and strict no-write behavior.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 977/2291 accepts the command as direct execution without resolving OEM schema or secret handling.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Manual and Auto cases change state; this case is read-only and may verify their state but cannot substitute for actual transitions.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 requires Project-approved OEM read method; ED-35 preserves control-mode plus all-fan coverage; ED-36 treats command/schema/map as readiness; ED-38 forbids clear/write/retry.

original_test_intent: Read and verify fan-control completion status, current manual/auto mode, encoded duty and all fan speeds without changing control state.
original_method: Issue the single approved read-only OEM query, decode its raw response against the pinned vendor schema, enumerate every mapped fan with unit/freshness-aware telemetry, and correlate mode/duty/speeds with WebUI and cooling reference.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves the raw read command/schema and fan map. The agent may collect/decode read-only evidence; operator reconciles UI/current context and engineer owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Approved read command and response layout
safety_requirements: Do not issue set-mode/set-duty or any write-capable raw command.
Do not substitute the DeepSeek 0x30/0x30 form for Master 0x30/0x22 without approval.
Keep credentials out of process listings and shared output.
Distinguish zero from absent, disabled or stale telemetry.
Stop on invalid completion/schema/identity without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Verify target identity and approved read command revision.
Capture raw response with bounded timeout and decode completion/mode/duty.
Enumerate all mapped fan sensors with RPM/PWM/status/timestamps.
Correlate WebUI and cooling reference without inferring mode from RPM alone.
Return redacted evidence and prove no control state changed.
engineer_actions: Resolve discrepancies and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unapproved and incomplete: it changes the OEM read command family, exposes secrets and provides grep output instead of decoded raw schema plus complete mapped sensors.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the owner-approved read command and parser with secret-safe authentication, timeout and complete fan enumeration; never substitute a write command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master 0x30 0x22, completion/mode/duty Criteria, Script and 20/10-minute values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform protected, schema-decoded control-state read plus complete freshness-aware fan telemetry correlation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the BMC/fan controller covered by the approved OEM schema.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC, OEM spec, parser/ipmitool and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor OEM fan-control query schema and Project cooling topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds schema authority, secret safety, complete mapping, units/freshness and no-write audit while retaining raw-mode/duty checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful raw response or grep list is partial; full coverage requires decoded completion/mode/duty and every mapped fan.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved command/schema, fan map and expected current-state context.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor-specific bytes can be misdecoded or accidentally replaced with a write command; stale RPM cannot prove current control behavior.

project_override_considerations: Alternate read interfaces require engineer-approved equivalence for completion/mode/duty and all fans, with explicit uncovered OEM/WebUI coverage; no override may change control state.
expected_evidence: Target identity, pinned command/schema and secret-safe audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master gives one coherent read command and response model; DeepSeek's differing suggestion is not source authority and is rejected pending Project approval.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only objective is clear; exact OEM schema, fan map and credentials are execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects command substitution/secret exposure and adds decoded schema, complete mapping and freshness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and strict read-only boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds OEM command authority and semantic/coverage gates beyond direct-run output.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps read-only state evidence distinct from manual/auto transitions.

review_improvement: Makes OEM bytes and response fields auditable, avoids accidental write-command substitution and requires every fan instead of a grep sample.
independent_technical_reasoning: Raw OEM responses have no portable meaning without a versioned schema, and nearby set commands can be dangerously similar. Mode cannot be inferred from RPM because automatic control may hold a steady duty; the exact decoded state plus complete time-stamped telemetry is required while preserving strict read-only operation.
